scope_entries.finding: official mcp SDK low-level Server over stdio_server, extra mcp>=1.2,<2, lazy _sdk() raising ServerExtraMissing -> CliError exit 2; tools.py has no third-party imports

one Verb registry drives argparse and MCP tool_specs; params_schema adds apply(default False) for mutating verbs; parity test is data-driven; MCP tests use mcp.shared.memory.create_connected_server_and_client_session in-process

reembed only selects model/dims mismatches and raw update_many sets status pending/attempts 0 without clearing error/next_attempt_at; JSON keys dry_run/model/dims/ids/count/updated are an existing contract
embed and classify run together all-or-nothing; there is no classify-only or embed-only path; reclassify on taxonomy change re-runs everything
404/429/5xx defer a pending doc via the in-memory _retry map only; the reason and retry time are discarded, so status cannot explain a non-draining backlog and a restart retries immediately
a re-enrich with unchanged content_hash emits nothing, so label changes from reclassification are never published

GatewayClient has embed (prompt_name Document hardcoded) and classify (/systemone) but no chat call; settings are named POCKETSYNC_ plus the upper-cased setting name, non-secret settings sit outside SECRET_SETTINGS

indexes recordings_summary_vec (filter) and recordings_chunk_vec (nestedRoot, parentFilter); FILTER_PATHS are labels/deleted_in_pocket/recording_at only; ensure_index only creates missing indexes; $vectorSearch is tested only in opt-in atlas-local integration tests
sensitive is enrichment.filters.sensitive (probability), absent when the decider did not answer; README says shareable only if present and low
chunks carry index/start/end/text/vector but no speaker (speaker lives in segments); nestedRoot search returns parent docs, so best-chunk selection must happen client-side

verbs register by hand, read through cached Runtime accessors that FakeRuntime overrides; surface tests require --json, --apply default off, explain/learn/overview entries; RUNTIME_VERBS gates grant re-exec
stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, loopback-only (ValueError on non-loopback), daemon-thread start/stop, run_until_signal; webhook_port setting only

remote-managed tunnel token (ingress lives in Cloudflare, set via cultureflare remote-login setup), Access on host + exact-path Bypass app; a second hostname needs only Cloudflare-side ingress, DNS and an Access app
'no UI' non-goal stated in these three; AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.colleague.md, .pi/SYSTEM.md have none; QWEN.md hard-codes the verb list
runtime is stdlib-only; new third-party libs go behind extras with lazy import
